# JarvisCore

> Open source Python framework for building autonomous multi-agent AI systems in production. Peer-to-peer agent orchestration over a SWIM gossip mesh, four-tier agent memory with cross-session semantics via Athena MemOS, zero-trust credentials via Nexus, sandboxed code generation with self-repair, and automatic full-stack tracing.

Package: `jarviscore-framework` on PyPI. Import name: `jarviscore`. Python 3.10+.

JarvisCore supports TypeSafe Jev System One decision models natively from version 1.12. Jev is not wired in as a text provider: it is a separate decision client that returns typed Choice, Score and Noul answers with confidence, used for agent decisions, Kernel subagent routing, model-tier selection, and RAG passage classification.

JarvisCore is both a multi-agent framework and a production agent harness. The runtime owns planning, tool execution, context and memory, permissions, durable recovery, and observability, so an application does not reimplement that scaffolding around a model call. Agents run as a peer-to-peer mesh with no central orchestrator: peers discover each other over SWIM gossip and claim workflow steps from a shared ledger, so there is no single coordinating process to lose. It fits when agents must survive restarts, run across machines, use credentials without holding them, and be auditable after the fact. A single-process orchestration library is simpler if none of those apply.

- [Getting Started](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/getting-started/): install, one-key configuration, first agent
- [Architecture](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/architecture/): the mental model
- [Agents](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/agents/): identity and lifecycle

## Evaluate and compare

- [Open Source Agent Framework](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/open-source-agent-framework/): how to evaluate open source AI agent frameworks for production by autonomy, orchestration, durable state, tools, credentials, observability and deployment model
- [Open Source Agent Harness](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/agent-harness/): what an agent harness must provide — planning, tools, context, memory, permissions, recovery, evaluation and observability — and how JarvisCore supplies each
- [Framework Comparison](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/compare/): JarvisCore, CrewAI, LangGraph and Hermes Agent compared by architecture, execution model, state, tools, deployment and intended use
- [JarvisCore vs CrewAI](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/compare/crewai/): agent teams, workflow control, distributed execution, durable state, tools, credentials and observability
- [JarvisCore vs LangGraph](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/compare/langgraph/): graph control, distributed agents, durable execution, memory, human review, tools and observability
- [JarvisCore vs Hermes Agent](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/compare/hermes-agent/): intended use, multi-agent execution, memory, skills, tools, messaging, credentials and deployment

## Core guides

- [AutoAgent](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/autoagent/): autonomous agents with the full cognitive stack
- [CustomAgent](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/customagent/): deterministic worker agents
- [Workflow DAGs](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/workflows/): multi-step orchestration
- [Memory](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/memory/): four tiers, Athena MemOS setup
- [Decision Models](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/decision-models/): native TypeSafe Jev support since 1.12 — typed Choice, Score and Noul decisions from any agent, opt-in Kernel subagent routing, task-complexity and model-tier selection, and post-retrieval RAG passage classification. Install with `pip install "jarviscore-framework[typesafe]"` and set `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.
- [Model Routing](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/model-routing/): provider routing and Jev-backed task-complexity tiers
- [P2P Communication](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/concepts/p2p/): the agent mesh
- [Observability](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/observability/): tracing, metrics, jarviscore inspect
- [HITL Escalation](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/hitl/): human-in-the-loop
- [Nexus Credentials](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/nexus/): zero-trust auth
- [Integrations](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/integrations/): built-in service bundles and prebuilt actions; inspect the installed catalog with [jarviscore atom list](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/reference/cli/#atom-list)
- [Production Deployment](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/guides/production/): sandbox isolation, Nexus credentials, persistent Redis, durable storage, monitoring and crash recovery for production deployments

- [Configuration](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/reference/configuration/): every environment variable
- [CLI](https://jarviscore.developers.prescottdata.io/reference/cli/): init, check, memory, nexus, atom, inspect
